newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply 600 bln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply 600 bln won to banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea plans to supply 600 billion won to local commercial banks through repurchase agreements to ease liquidity shortage, an official at the central bank said on Wednesday.

The money will be provided to banks on Wednesday with the repurchase agreements maturing on January 23, one day after the central bank is due to review the won reserve levels at commercial banks, he said.
"I think today's fund supply will help stabilise the money market for the time being," said the official, who asked not to be named.
He did not say what caused the liquidity shortage.
